title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10 Premieres with a Fresh Lineup of 16 Contestants
excerpt: Host Akkineni Nagarjuna welcomed 16 new contestants into the Bigg Boss house as Season 10 kicked off with high energy.
content:
Bigg Boss Telugu 10 premiered this week with host Akkineni Nagarjuna introducing 16 contestants to the house. The lineup includes television actors, film stars, comedians, and social media personalities, promising an entertaining season ahead.

The opening episode saw contestants take part in an introductory task designed to test their compatibility and communication skills. Fans have already started picking their favorites on social media, with early buzz around several strong personalities in the house.

Stay tuned for the latest updates, elimination news, and voting trends throughout the season.
author: BB Telugu Team

title: First Captaincy Task Sparks Early Drama in the House
excerpt: Tempers flared during the season's first captaincy task as contestants jostled for an early advantage in the game.
content:
The first captaincy task of Bigg Boss Telugu 10 turned heated as contestants pushed hard to secure the coveted captain's position. Strategic alliances began to form, with several housemates already emerging as strong game players.

The task tested physical endurance and negotiation skills, leading to a few heated exchanges between contestants. The results will be revealed in the upcoming weekend episode.
author: BB Telugu Team

title: First Nominations of Bigg Boss Telugu 10 Announced
excerpt: The house went through its first nomination process, setting up an intense week of voting for fans.
content:
Bigg Boss Telugu 10 saw its first nomination round this week, with several contestants facing the possibility of elimination. The nomination task required housemates to justify their choices directly to their fellow contestants, leading to candid conversations and a few disagreements.

Fans can now vote for their favorite contestants to save them from elimination through the official Hotstar app and other approved voting channels.
author: BB Telugu Team

title: Surprise Secret Task Shakes Up House Dynamics
excerpt: A hidden task assigned to select contestants added a new layer of strategy and suspicion inside the house.
content:
Bigg Boss surprised the house with a secret task assigned only to a handful of contestants. Sworn to secrecy, the chosen housemates had to complete hidden objectives without raising suspicion among the others.

The task led to a few tense moments as contestants tried to figure out who among them was carrying out the secret assignment, adding fresh entertainment value to the season.
author: BB Telugu Team

title: Weekend Mirchi: Nagarjuna Reviews the House's First Week
excerpt: Host Nagarjuna addressed the housemates during the first Weekend Mirchi episode, calling out key moments from the week.
content:
During the first Weekend Mirchi episode of the season, host Akkineni Nagarjuna reviewed the housemates' performance over the week. He praised a few contestants for their game sense while pulling up others for their behavior during tasks.

The episode also featured fun games and interactions with the housemates, giving fans a lighter look at life inside the Bigg Boss house.
author: BB Telugu Team

title: Fans React to Early Friendships and Rivalries in the House
excerpt: Social media is buzzing with reactions to the early bonds and clashes forming among the Bigg Boss Telugu 10 contestants.
content:
Just days into the new season, fans have taken to social media to discuss the friendships and rivalries taking shape inside the Bigg Boss Telugu 10 house. Several contestant pairings have become fan favorites, while a few early disagreements have sparked debate among viewers.

With voting now open, fans are encouraged to support their favorite contestants through the official voting channels each week.
author: BB Telugu Team
